subject.title: Feature: Talk Mode Idle Timeout / Auto-Deactivation After Voice Wake

question: What public Talk idle-timeout contract should OpenClaw support for deactivating inactive Talk sessions after Voice Wake starts them?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public lifecycle and configuration behavior that affects compatibility and cross-platform Talk semantics.

options.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
options.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, bounds, disabled behavior, reset events, and macOS runtime support.

options.title: Scope only to Voice Wake-started Talk
options.body: Track activation source and auto-deactivate only Talk sessions started by Voice Wake, leaving manually started Talk sessions unchanged.

options.title: Defer to broader voice lifecycle design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers design a larger Talk and Voice Wake lifecycle policy that also covers realtime and mobile behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
recommendation.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, bounds, disabled behavior, reset events, and macOS runtime support.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is primarily about Talk config and product lifecycle semantics, where steipete has the strongest adjacent history in the inspected evidence.
